edges: Mirabell will lose £6000 of Millamant's inheritance if Lady Wishfort marries.
Lady Wishfort is encouraged by Foible to marry the supposed Sir Rowland.
Mirabell offers to help Lady Wishfort out of an embarrassing situation if she consents to his marriage.
Lady Wishfort offers Mirabell her consent to the marriage if he can save her fortune and honour.
Lady Wishfort wants Millamant to marry her nephew, Sir Wilfull Witwoud.
Fainall blackmails Lady Wishfort using information about Mrs. Fainall's affair and Millamant's contract.
Fainall informs Mirabell that should Lady Wishfort marry, he will lose £6000 of Millamant's inheritance.
Foible encourages Lady Wishfort to marry Sir Rowland.
Sir Rowland is actually Waitwell in disguise, planning to marry Lady Wishfort.
Fainall blackmails Lady Wishfort using information about Mrs. Fainall's affair with Mirabell.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mirabell restores Mrs. Fainall's property to her possession.
Fainall accuses Mrs. Marwood of loving Mirabell.
